shortIntro.title: What Your Device Needs for Smooth Roblox Gameplay 🧱⚡🎮
shortIntro.para1: Roblox isn’t just one game — it’s millions of user‑made worlds 🌍. Some are light, some are heavy, and some can push your device hard. For smooth performance you need efficient hardware, sustained GPU power, and stable thermals.
shortIntro.para2: Though Roblox looks simple, advanced maps, shadows and physics can push phones to their limits 😭📱. A stronger processor, faster storage, and solid internet help reduce lag, rubber‑banding, and unexpected drops 🕳️😐.

intro: Below are the updated minimum and recommended specifications required to run Roblox smoothly on Android and iOS devices 📱💨. These values are based on official requirements and real‑world testing across popular Roblox games.

recommended.Internet: Fast 4G/5G or stable Wi‑Fi for online multiplayer 📡

ios_intro: Roblox on iOS performs efficiently due to tight optimization, leading to smoother experiences on many titles 🍏.

sectionIntro: Here are well‑known Android and iOS devices that deliver reliable, often lag‑free Roblox performance — even in busy scenes 💥🛡️.
androidDevices: Samsung Galaxy A54 / A74 / S21–S24 Series 🌌
storageIntroText: Roblox storage varies by game world — tiny maps need little, while large worlds can download tons of assets 📦:
faqIntroText: Here are the most commonly asked Roblox performance questions — answered simply and honestly 🎤😄.

faqList.question: Why does Roblox lag on my phone? 🥲
faqList.answer: Devices below recommended hardware often struggle due to limited CPU/GPU and app optimization.

faqList.question: Does Roblox support 120Hz on mobile? 🔄
faqList.answer: Roblox mobile is usually capped at ~60 FPS; some high refresh rate effects depend on device and game. Performance may improve with settings changes. ⚙️

faqList.question: Why do some Roblox games lag more than others? 🤔
faqList.answer: Each game is made by different creators. Some worlds are optimized, others use intensive features that demand more from your device.
